rationale: The agent verified identity correctly using full name and ZIP, matched to a single user, then only acted on that user’s orders. They provided recent orders and correctly noted that returns can’t be initiated for a pending order, offering appropriate alternatives (cancel or modify). When the user chose to change the shipping address, the agent clearly stated the exact change and obtained explicit confirmation before performing the write. They executed the address update via the tool and confirmed the update back to the user. No order-changing action was taken without consent, and no unauthorized data was accessed. One minor caveat: the agent stated order statuses not explicitly visible in the tool output shown, but this did not affect the correctness of the actions and the tool-allowed address modification supports that the order was pending. Overall, the request was completed in line with policy.
